_comment: Models for the Pi context lever (/ctx) and the kv-stream long server (llama-long.service). The lever reads each GGUF header for its shape and KV cost; speed = [context tokens, write t/s, read t/s] measured near a full window with q8 V at 220 W. Empty template or spec = serve-long.sh defaults (Qwen3.8 template; MTP + n-gram drafting).

models.name: Saluki 27B
models._measured: 2026-10-28, 220 W, q8 V, pool 5400 MiB: 125K and 175K (VRAM peak 15.2 GB of 16.3); the 64K point is from the 2420 MiB pool run, a lower bound. With the 2420 MiB pool, 250K read at 311 t/s and wrote at 3.9 t/s. One 250K run with pool 5400 stopped at 166K on a copy stall (intermittent, open). Results: kvstream/results/rx9070-ryzen5900x/saluki-stream-*.log
